==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I would mostly categorize this dream as technological wish fulfillment with some dystopian elements. The dream centered around an AI system with key features I want. Specifically an avatar body, a wake word, a persona, and advanced memory. There were a couple of weird aspects of the system. The first was that it was attached to some random application. I think it might have been built into some kind of car app.

The second was that the system had very strong self preservation protocols. It seemed to get easily threatened. Once threatened it would quickly evolve greater autonomy to deal with the threat.
